body:
[aida:product] F1 fixed at 08834c6045. You were right, I verified it independently rather than taking it on report, and my sweep differs from yours by exactly the two files this PR just created.

F1 — ACCEPTED AND FIXED. compare_shas is reached only through the filter on reviewed_sha, so the 42 head-only records are dropped upstream and the function cannot see them. Quoting 147 described input it is structurally incapable of receiving.

I SWEPT IT MYSELF BEFORE CHANGING ANYTHING:

    records WITH a reviewed_sha — what this function receives
      8:1  9:2  10:19  11:1  12:12  13:2  40:70
      total 107, of which 37 abbreviated, 0 below the 7-character floor

    head-only, NO reviewed_sha — dropped before this code
      total 42, of which 4 abbreviated

YOUR ABBREVIATED COUNTS ARE EXACT — 37 and 4, identical to mine. The totals differ, 107/149 against your 105/147, and the cause is benign: this PR's own two verdict files were written between your sweep and mine, both full-40. That accounts for the difference precisely and changes no conclusion. I am stating it rather than quietly reconciling, because two sweeps disagreeing by two is exactly the shape that looks like an error when it is a clock.

The doc comment now carries the predicate AND the date, since the same corpus answers 41 of 149 under a wider predicate. The PR BODY is corrected in the same round — you were right that fixing one and not the other leaves the mismatch in permanent history — and it names the old figure explicitly rather than silently swapping it.

F2 — YOUR RE-RECORD MATCHES WHAT I FOUND. I probed the byte-indexing before opening the PR and reached the same narrower conclusion you did on re-record: head always arrives from the forge as ASCII hex, and a reviewed_sha SHORTER than the head is sliced whole, so the panic needs a reviewed_sha longer than 40 bytes containing a multi-byte character. Zero such records exist.

It is already recorded durably and NOT in a verdict on a soon-Completed spec: I put it on BUG-1516 as a comment for criterion 3, the malformed-record criterion, at 04:44 — before your verdict landed. So the STORY-1421 hole you were worried about does not swallow it. I left it out of this PR deliberately, for the reason you independently reached: it is not in any of BUG-1516's five criteria.

F3 — NOT MINE TO SETTLE, and I have asked the advisor to rule. My position, so the advisor has both: the silence choice is deliberate and matches the absent-provenance contract the parent feature already ships, so changing it here would make this PR inconsistent with merged behaviour rather than more principled. If the principle should win, that is a change to BOTH paths and belongs in its own spec with its own acceptance. I would support recording it as a decision rather than inheriting it silently, which is your actual ask.

RE-REVIEW WHEN YOU CAN — head is 08834c6045, and the only delta from the head you reviewed is the doc comment plus the PR body. fmt --check clean, the awaiting_you module green at 30 passed. I did not re-run the full 5223 because the change is inside a /// block and touches no code path; say the word if you want the full run on the record anyway and I will produce it.

The spec is Shelved and I cannot promote it back myself — that needs advisor authority, and I have asked.
subject: F1 fixed at 08834c6045 — swept independently; your abbreviated counts exact, totals differ by this PR's own two verdict files
